display.purpose: Hero headlines only. One per page.

label.purpose: Badges, metadata, tags, data labels. Uppercase.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Orange fill conveys action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ee7900; color: #fff; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 10px; border: none; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -3px rgba(238,121,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -5px rgba(238,121,0,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #002857; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #fff; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid #fff; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fff; color: #002857; transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -5px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96); }

components.name: Platform Card

components.html:
Jul-IA

Analiza 7,693+ propiedades en tiempo real. Calcula el ROI de cada una.

components.css: .ds-card-platform { background: #f9fafb; padding: 2.5rem; border-radius: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.4s ease; } .ds-card-platform:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0,40,87,0.15); } .ds-card-icon { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #25d366, #128c7e); color: #fff; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1f2937; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-card-subtitle { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #ee7900; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-desc { color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; flex: 1; } .ds-card-cta { color: #002857; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Citrino's visual system communicates institutional intelligence — the feeling of walking into a war room where every decision is backed by verified data. The palette anchors on deep navy for authority, with orange as the signal that sparks insight and emerald as the return on that insight. Typography pairs a precise geometric sans (Sora) with a warm, readable humanist sans (Source Sans 3). Layout favors generous vertical rhythm, asymmetrical composition, and data that breathes.
keyCharacteristics: Data-forward: metrics and numbers are visual elements
Institutional weight: deep colors, controlled typography
Precision: every token has a job

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is for intelligence and action. It's the color of insight, not decoration. Every orange element must communicate 'pay attention — there's a signal here.'

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows only appear as response to state (hover, focus), not as ambient decoration.

dos: Do use orange sparingly — its rarity is the point
Do let numbers and metrics breathe as visual elements
Do use dark navy backgrounds for primary sections
Do pair Sora headlines with Source Sans 3 body for contrast
donts: Don't use house icons, warm family photos, or 'find your dream home' clichés
Don't use identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated endlessly
Don't put an all-caps tracked eyebrow above every section heading
